svg.aria-label: Material board of nine samples: existing brick, lime plaster, terracotta tile, reclaimed pine, the existing timber doors, woven palm fiber, basalt pavers, safety glass and stonecrop, each tagged as existing, reused, local or living
svg.title: Material board
svg.text: Walls and piers, cleaned and repointed in lime
Interior walls and ceiling, breathable and repairable
Floor, 30 x 30 cm, laid on the existing slab
Entrance pair, repaired and oil-finished in place
Garden walk, laid on sand, no concrete
Replaces broken panes in the existing frames
Material board | Drawn by Raymundo "R@y" Olguin | GreenStore, Puebla
